questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding 'Malwan', the second Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft delivered to the Indian Navy in 2026?

options.text: It was designed and built by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL).
It features less than 50% indigenous content in its construction.
It is named after a coastal town in Punjab.
It is a 5,000-ton destroyer intended for deep-sea blue-water operations.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It was designed and built by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL).**__

 __
 
• Displacement - 1,100 tons (Shallow Water Craft, not a deep-sea destroyer).
 
• Propulsion - High-efficiency Waterjets for maneuverability.
 
• Roles - Anti-Submarine Warfare, Mine Warfare, and Low Intensity Maritime Operations (LIMO).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Malwan Legacy__

 __
 
• The new craft carries forward the name of a former Indian Naval Minesweeper that served until 2003.
 
 
 
• ASW SWC Project__
 __
 
• Objective - To replace the Abhay-class ASW corvettes and provide effective sub-surface surveillance in coastal waters.
 
 
 
• Armament__
 
 
• Equipped with torpedoes, anti-submarine rockets, and advanced hull-mounted sonar.

questions.question: The term ‘Anvesha’ was in news. What is it all about?

options.text: A third generation fire & forget Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile developed by DRDO
A deep space probe for asteroid exploration planned for launch in 2030
An indigenous navigation system for Indian Navy's P81 Poseidon survelliance aircraft
An Earth observation satellite developed by DRDO and launched by ISRO

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**An Earth observation satellite developed by DRDO and launched by ISRO.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **ISRO launched the PSLV-C62 mission carrying the Anvesha or EOS-N1 Earth observation satellite into a sun-synchronous polar orbit in January 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anvesha, also known as EOS-N1, is an Earth observation satellite launched aboard PSLV-C62.**
 
• The satellite was developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation.
 
• It provides advanced imaging capabilities to map enemy positions with high accuracy.
 
• The satellite was placed into a sun-synchronous polar orbit for continuous Earth monitoring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Earth Observation Satellites__

 __
 
• Used to capture high-resolution images of the Earth’s surface
 
• Support defence surveillance, disaster management, agriculture and mapping
 
 
 
• Sun-Synchronous Orbit__
 __
 
• A near-polar orbit where the satellite passes over the same part of Earth at the same local solar time
 
• Ensures consistent lighting conditions for imaging and observation
 
 
 
• PSLV-C62__
 __
 
• The 64th launch of India’s Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle
 
• Used for deploying Earth observation and commercial satellites
 
 
 
• NewSpace India Limited__
 
 
• The commercial arm of ISRO responsible for executing satellite launch missions
 
• Handles dedicated commercial launches for Indian and foreign customers

questions.question: What is the name of the hand-operated portable water purification system developed by DRDO for soldiers deployed in remote and extreme conditions?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sea Water Desalination System (SWaDeS).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DRDO has developed a hand-operated Sea Water Desalination System (SWaDeS) to provide potable drinking water to soldiers in remote and water-scarce regions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The system is named Sea Water Desalination System (SWaDeS).**
 
• It has been developed by the Defence Laboratory, Jodhpur, under DRDO.
 
• SWaDeS can be operated manually or with an engine, making it suitable for field conditions.
 
• SWaDeS Capabilities__ 
 __
 
• Converts saline water into safe drinking water
 
• Lightweight and portable for deployment in difficult terrain
 
• Enhances operational self-sufficiency of soldiers
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Operational Capacity__

 __
 
• Manual version can be carried by a single soldier
 
• Supports drinking water needs of 10–12 personnel in emergencies
 
• Engine-operated version can support 20–25 soldiers
 
 
 
• Technical Features__
 __
 
• Reduces salinity from about 35,000 mg/L TDS to below 500 mg/L
 
• Suitable for long-range patrols and isolated deployments
 
• Designed for rapid deployment and ease of use
 
 
 
• Strategic Use__
 
 
• Useful in coastal and naval operations
 
• Can be deployed in inland saline areas such as Pangong Tso
 
• Strengthens logistics support in high-altitude and border regions

questions.question: In August 2025, which organisation received an order worth Rs. 62000 crores for 97 LCA Mk1A fighter jets from the Indian government?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**HAL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)** is a premier aerospace and defense company in India, established in **1940**.
 
• In **August 2025**, HAL received a significant order worth **Rs. 62,000 crores** from the Indian government for the production of **97 LCA Mk1A fighter jets**.
 
• The **LCA Mk1A (Light Combat Aircraft)** Tejas is an indigenously designed and developed fighter aircraft aimed at enhancing India's defense capabilities.
 
• This order is part of India's efforts to promote **self-reliance** in defense manufacturing under the **Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative**.
 
• HAL is headquartered in **Bangalore, Karnataka**, and has been a critical player in developing India's defense and aerospace infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited):**
 
 
• Founded in **1940**, HAL is one of the oldest and largest aerospace and defense manufacturers in the world.
 
• It is involved in the design, development, and production of aircraft, helicopters, engines, avionics, and other defense-related equipment.
 
• HAL has played a key role in India's defense projects, including the **LCA Tejas, Dhruv helicopters, and Sukhoi aircraft assembly**.
 
 
 
• **LCA Mk1A Fighter Jets:**
 
 
• The **LCA Tejas Mk1A** is a fourth-generation, single-engine, multi-role aircraft developed by India.
 
• Features include **enhanced avionics, better radar systems, electronic warfare capabilities, and reduced maintenance requirements**.
 
• It is designed for air-to-air combat, ground attacks, and reconnaissance missions.
 
• The production of the Mk1A variant supports India's goal of reducing reliance on foreign defense imports and promoting indigenous manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat Initiative:**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India in **2020**, the initiative aims to make India self-reliant across various sectors, including defense manufacturing.
 
• Under this program, India emphasizes indigenous development and procurement of defense equipment.
 
• The HAL order for LCA Mk1A jets aligns with this vision of boosting domestic production capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Other Organizations:**
 
 
• **DRDO (Defense Research and Development Organization):** Responsible for research and development in defense technologies but does not manufacture aircraft.
 
• **AWE India:** Not involved in aircraft production; focuses on other engineering applications.
 
• **AVANI:** A less prominent player in defense manufacturing compared to HAL.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Significance of HAL:**
 
 
• HAL has contributed to several landmark projects, including the assembly of **Sukhoi Su-30MKI** aircraft and the development of **Dhruv helicopters**.
 
• Its collaboration with **ISRO** on space-related projects highlights its versatility beyond defense manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of LCA Tejas:**
 
 
• The Tejas program showcases India's ability to design and produce advanced fighter aircraft indigenously.
 
• It reduces dependency on foreign suppliers and enhances India's defense preparedness.
 
 
</ul

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Exercise Vayushakti-2026':

I. It is a bilateral air exercise conducted between the Indian Air Force and the Republic of Singapore Air Force.

II. It took place at the Pokhran Range in Rajasthan on February 27, 2026.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**II only.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Air Force (IAF) is set to conduct 'Exercise Vayushakti-2026', a massive firepower demonstration, on February 27, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement I is incorrect:** Exercise Vayushakti is **not a bilateral exercise** with any foreign nation (like Singapore). It is an **indigenous, internal firepower demonstration** conducted by the Indian Air Force to showcase its full spectrum of combat capabilities.
 
• **Statement II is correct:** The exercise was held at the **Pokhran Range in Rajasthan** on February 27, 2026. This desert range is the traditional venue for showcasing the IAF's offensive and defensive prowess.
 
• The exercise will feature a wide array of aircraft, including the **Rafale, Sukhoi-30 MKI, Tejas (LCA), Mirage 2000**, and various attack helicopters like the **Prachand (LCH) and Apache**.
 
• Objectives of Vayushakti-26__
 __
 
• To demonstrate the IAF's capability to deliver **precision-guided munitions** and heavy ordinance at targets on the ground and in the air.
 
• To showcase the seamless integration of **indigenous technology** and weapons systems under the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.
 
• To simulate real-time war scenarios, including long-range strikes and air defense operations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Frequency__

 __
 
• Exercise Vayushakti is typically held every **three years (triennial)**. The last edition took place in 2024 (after a slight delay from the 2022 schedule).
 
 
 
• Related IAF Exercises__
 __
 
• **Gagan Shakti:** A pan-India exercise to test the IAF's readiness across all commands.
 
• **Tarang Shakti:** The largest international multilateral air exercise hosted by India.
 
• **Exercise Garuda:** A bilateral air exercise specifically between India and **France**.
 
 
 
• Night Capabilities__
 
 
• A significant highlight of Vayushakti is often the **night-firing demonstration**, proving the IAF's ability to operate in 24/7 all-weather conditions.

questions.question: What is the name of the long-range glide bomb successfully tested by DRDO from a Su-30 MKI aircraft in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaurav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Gaurav** is the name of the long-range glide bomb successfully tested by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** from a **Su-30 MKI aircraft** in **2025**.

• The glide bomb is developed by DRDO to enhance the precision strike capability of Indian Air Force (IAF) aircraft.

• The bomb is equipped with advanced guidance systems, allowing it to accurately hit distant targets over a long range.

• It is designed to be integrated with fighter jets like the Su-30 MKI, which is one of the most advanced multirole aircraft in the Indian Air Force.

• The successful test of the **Gaurav glide bomb** demonstrates India's growing capability in indigenous weapon development and boosts the nation's defense preparedness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **DRDO:**

• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is an agency under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, responsible for developing technology for the armed forces.

• Established in **1958**, DRDO works on a wide range of projects, including missiles, aircraft, radar systems, and more.

• It has played a pivotal role in strengthening India's defense capabilities through indigenous development.

• **Su-30 MKI Aircraft:**

• The **Su-30 MKI** is a multirole fighter jet developed by Russia's Sukhoi and modified for the Indian Air Force by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL).

• It features advanced avionics, thrust-vectoring engines, and can carry a wide variety of weapons, including bombs, missiles, and rockets.

• The aircraft is a key part of India's air defense strategy and is widely regarded for its versatility and performance.

• **Glide Bombs:**

• Glide bombs are precision-guided munitions that glide toward their target after being released from an aircraft.

• They are equipped with navigation and guidance systems, enabling long-range strikes with high accuracy.

• These bombs are used to hit strategic and tactical targets in defense operations.

• **Other DRDO Developments:**

• DRDO has developed several notable weapons systems, including the **BrahMos missile**, **Akash air defense system**, and **Agni series of ballistic missiles**.

• Its focus on indigenous technology development has significantly reduced India's reliance on foreign defense imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Prithvi:**

• The **Prithvi missile** is a short-range, surface-to-surface ballistic missile developed by DRDO.

• It is not a glide bomb and is designed primarily for tactical battlefield roles.

• **Agni:**

• The **Agni series** consists of medium to intercontinental-range ballistic missiles developed by DRDO.

• These missiles are used for strategic deterrence rather than air-launched bomb applications.

• **BrahMos:**

• The **BrahMos** missile is a supersonic cruise missile jointly developed by India and Russia.

• It is not a glide bomb but is widely used for precision strikes against high-value targets.

• **Significance of Glide Bombs:**

• Glide bombs like **Gaurav** offer a cost-effective way to achieve precision strikes without requiring sophisticated missile systems.

• They are particularly useful in modern aerial warfare, where accuracy and range are critical.

</ul

questions.question: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) conducted a successful qualification level load test for which component of the Gaganyaan programme?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaganyaan Drogue Parachute.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** **successfully conducted the qualification level load test for the Drogue Parachute of the Gaganyaan programme at the RTRS facility in Chandigarh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The test was conducted at the Rail Track Rocket Sled facility of Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory, Chandigarh.**
 
• The qualification level load test simulated loads higher than maximum flight loads to ensure additional design safety margin.
 
• The test was carried out in collaboration with Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, ISRO and Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment, DRDO.
 
• The successful test demonstrated India’s capability in designing and manufacturing high strength ribbon parachutes for human spaceflight missions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gaganyaan Programme:** India’s first human spaceflight mission aimed at sending Indian astronauts into low Earth orbit.
 
• **Drogue Parachute:** A small stabilizing parachute deployed at high altitude to reduce speed and ensure stable descent before the main parachute deployment.
 
• **Rail Track Rocket Sled (RTRS):** A specialized dynamic testing facility used for high-speed aerodynamic and ballistic evaluations.
 
• **Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory (TBRL):** A DRDO laboratory based in Chandigarh providing advanced testing, instrumentation and technical support for defence and space programmes.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of Mission Sudarshan Chakra as highlighted in the Defence Forces Vision 2047?

options.text: To establish a dedicated space command for the military
To create an impenetrable, layered missile defence system
To build a comprehensive drone force for surveillance
To develop a cognitive warfare action force

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To create an impenetrable, layered missile defence system**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Defence Secretary **Rajesh Kumar Singh** stated that India is on course to become a fully integrated military force capable of projecting power across the Indo-Pacific region by **2047**.
 
• The **Defence Forces Vision 2047** outlines a roadmap for a future-ready Indian military, including the maturation of **Mission Sudarshan Chakra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Sudarshan Chakra:** It is designed to act as a national defence shield. Its primary objective is to give the country an **impenetrable, layered missile defence system** to protect critical strategic and civilian assets.
 
• **Timeline:** This shield is expected to be operational in the **2030s** and will mature during the military's consolidation period from **2030 to 2040**.
 
• **Other Options:** Establishing a space command, creating a drone force, and developing a cognitive warfare action force are also goals under the broader **Defence Forces Vision 2047**, but they are separate initiatives and do not define the specific objective of Mission Sudarshan Chakra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defence Forces Vision 2047:** Unveiled in March, it aims to transform the Indian military into a technologically advanced, fully integrated, and multi-domain force.
 
• **Military Transformation Phases:** Transition process up to **2030**, consolidation period from **2030 to 2040**, and an era of excellence from **2040** when the military becomes an all-domain force.
 
• **Defence Procurement Manual 2025:** It has been revised to ensure a complete level playing field for the private sector, removing past provisions for public sector reservation or nomination.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• India maintains an approach of **multi-alignment** and **strategic autonomy**.
 
• According to the Defence Secretary, strategic autonomy is only achievable through technological sovereignty, supported by the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiative which is transitioning India from a major importer to a global defence manufacturing hub.

questions.question: With reference to the Pralay missile system recently tested by DRDO, consider the following statements:

options.text: It is a quasi-ballistic missile capable of manoeuvring during the terminal phase to evade missile defence systems.
It is a nuclear-capable missile developed as part of India’s strategic nuclear deterrence under the Nuclear Command Authority.
It is a hypersonic cruise missile that follows a low-altitude terrain-hugging flight profile throughout its trajectory.
It is an intercontinental ballistic missile designed to deliver payloads beyond 5,500 km.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• DRDO conducted a successful salvo launch of two *Pralay* missiles from the same launcher as part of user evaluation trials off the Odisha coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Pralay is a quasi-ballistic, surface-to-surface missile with advanced manoeuvrability and terminal guidance, enabling it to evade enemy air and missile defence systems. **Hence, Option A is correct. **
 
• Pralay is a conventional missile system and is not meant for nuclear delivery under India’s nuclear deterrence framework. **Hence, Option B is incorrect. **
 
• Cruise missiles (e.g., BrahMos) follow terrain-hugging profiles, whereas Pralay follows a ballistic trajectory with terminal manoeuvres. **Hence, Option C is incorrect. **
 
• Intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) exceed 5,500 km range, while Pralay is a short-range system. **Hence, Option D is incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pralay is derived from Prithvi Defence Vehicle (PDV) interceptor technologies, showcasing dual-use advancements in India’s missile ecosystem.
 
• The salvo launch capability highlights force multiplication, rapid response, and saturation potential against adversary defences.

questions.question: Which one of the following best explains the significance of stand-off strike capability?

options.text: It requires aircraft to directly enter heavily defended enemy airspace before launching weapons.
It eliminates the need for precision-guided munitions in aerial warfare.
It enables aircraft to strike targets from safer distances beyond many enemy defence zones.
It is relevant only for naval submarines.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Recent defence trials involving the TARA system highlighted advancements in stand-off strike capability and long-range precision engagement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Stand-off strike capability allows aircraft or platforms to engage enemy targets from long distances while remaining outside the effective range of many hostile air-defence systems.This improves survivability and reduces operational risk during combat missions. **Hence, Option C is correct. **
 
• Stand-off strike systems are specifically designed to avoid the need for aircraft to enter heavily defended enemy airspace before launching weapons. **Hence, Option A is incorrect. **
 
• Precision-guided munitions remain essential for accurate long-range stand-off strikes. **Hence, Option B is incorrect. **
 
• Stand-off strike capability is used across multiple military platforms including aircraft, ships, and land-based systems, and is not limited to naval submarines. **Hence, Option D is incorrect. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Modern air-defence systems significantly influence aerial warfare doctrines and strike planning.
 
• Precision-guided munitions are important components of strategic deterrence and military effectiveness.
 
• Extended-range strike capabilities improve operational depth and flexibility during military operations.
 
• Stand-off weapons reduce the exposure of pilots and platforms to enemy radar and missile systems.

questions.question: The term “AS-HAPS”, is best described as:

options.text: A space-based small satellite constellation for tactical communication under GSAT series.
An airship-based high-altitude pseudo-satellite platform for persistent ISR missions.
A long-endurance unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) developed under the Make-II category.
A ground-based over-the-horizon radar system for maritime domain awareness.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for an airship-based high-altitude pseudo-satellite (AS-HAPS) platform for the Indian Air Force to enable persistent Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• AS-HAPS refers to an airship-based high-altitude pseudo-satellite platform designed for persistent ISR missions. **Hence, Option B is correct. **
 
• GSAT satellites are space-based communication platforms and are not airship-based pseudo-satellites. **Hence, Option A is incorrect. **
 
• UCAVs are combat drones and distinct from high-altitude pseudo-satellites meant for station-keeping ISR. **Hence, Option C is incorrect. **
 
• Over-the-horizon radars are ground-based sensors for long-range detection and not airborne pseudo-satellites. **Hence, Option D is incorrect. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• HAPS operate in the stratosphere, bridging the gap between satellites and conventional UAVs.
 
• Pseudo-satellites can provide persistent coverage with lower cost and easier recoverability than space assets.
 
• ISR includes ELINT, telecommunications interception and EO/IR sensing.
 
• AS-HAPS enhances standoff surveillance and deterrence posture.
